meta.description: How a contracted CFM56-7B shop's capacity responds to an airline's committed (long-term contracted) volume. Three scenarios over years 0..6. All thresholds and shares marked no_source are our assumptions for a synthetic exercise; the grounding lines cite public industry figures only for orders of magnitude.

expansion_step_visits_per_year.source: B: a single shop expansion adds roughly +30 to +150 shop visits/yr, e.g. SAESM (Safran/RAM, Morocco) 70 -> 100 visits/yr by 2026; MTU Maintenance Zhuhai +50% to ~450 visits/yr after its expansion

expansion_lead_years.source: B: announced shop expansions take 2-4 years from decision to first added capacity (SAESM, MTU Zhuhai timelines)

tat_improvement_per_year.source: B: GE reports LEAP / CFM56 turnaround time improving by more than 10%/yr from flow (lean) production in its overhaul network

world_cfm56_shop_visits_per_year.source: B: world CFM56 shop visits ~2,300-2,400/yr through 2028 (trade press / OEM outlook); demand is roughly flat, so added capacity is not absorbed by market growth

slot_allocation_rule.source: B: network shops allocate induction slots roughly in proportion to each customer's contracted (long-term agreement) volume

airline_visits_per_year.source: A (this repo): baselines/jal-2026-10.json and baselines/ana-2026-10.json norms.visits_per_year

commit_threshold_visits_per_year.source: no_source: committed volume at or above which the shop treats the airline as an anchor customer and adds capacity

expansion_lag_years.source: no_source: middle of the public 2-4 year range

expansion_step_visits_per_year.source: no_source: low end of the public +30..+150 range (one line, not a new hangar)

shop_total_visits_per_year.source: no_source: order of magnitude of one large network shop (SAESM 100, MTU Zhuhai 450)

long_term_price_discount.source: no_source: price concession for long-term committed volume

congestion_price_step_per_year.source: no_source: annual price increase while the shop is congested

congestion_utilisation_threshold.source: no_source: shop utilisation above which quotes are raised

shop_utilisation_year0.source: no_source: today's shop-level utilisation (congested world, cf. README 混雑世界)

tat_floor_share.source: no_source: TAT cannot fall below 60% of today's quoted TAT (test and logistics floor)

B.name: 契約量に応じて増強
B.slots: if V >= threshold: shop adds expansion_step visits/yr after expansion_lag years; airline's extra visits/yr = V / shop_total * expansion_step
B.price: -3% from the year the long-term contract starts (year 1)

C.name: 混雑を価格に転嫁
C.slots: unchanged; effective capacity rises via shorter TAT
C.price: +5%/yr while shop utilisation > 0.90; utilisation falls with TAT because demand is flat
